# Ali Abbas Kazmi

> Web Developer, WordPress Specialist, and Automation Builder based in Islamabad, Pakistan.

Ali builds, manages, fixes, scales, and monitors WordPress sites, and designs automation
workflows with Zapier and GoHighLevel. He works as a WordPress Expert and Website Manager
at a UK-based agency, and is currently completing a BS in Computer Science at the
University of the People while working on microcontroller-based hardware projects.
